class.name: MidiNote
class.description: [method MidiDriver.note_on] returns one. MIDI itself knows a note only by its channel and key, so two notes on the same key and channel cannot be told apart; a [MidiNote] refers to exactly one of them. Dropping the reference does not end the note. A note with no length sounds until [method off] (or [method MidiDriver.note_off], or the transport stopping) ends it. [codeblock] var n := midi.note_on(1, 60, 100) await get_tree().create_timer(0.5).timeout n.off() [/codeblock]

method.name: brightness
method.description: The note's brightness, 0 to 1: MPE's timbre, CC 74 where it degrades to MIDI. Takes an optional [param at], like every message.

method.name: express
method.description: Sets one of the note's expressions ([enum NoteExpression]) to [param value]: for this note only, not its whole channel. The named methods ([method tune], [method volume] ...) do the same. How a target applies it, best first: a plugin taking per-note expressions natively (CLAP note expressions, VST3 Note Expression) gets it as such; a [MidiOutput] with [member MidiOutput.mpe] gives the note a channel of its own; otherwise pressure goes as polyphonic aftertouch, and the others only while the note is alone on its channel (where the channel message is exact), and are dropped on chords, with one warning. Takes an optional [param at], like every message.

method.name: expression
method.description: The note's expression, 0 to 1, as the plugin defines it (often a swell). Takes an optional [param at], like every message.

method.name: get_id
method.description: The note's id, unique within its driver. Targets receive it as [code]note_id[/code] with each of the note's events.

method.name: get_key
method.description: The note's key, 0 to 127 (60 is middle C).

method.name: is_active
method.description: [code]true[/code] until the note has ended: while it waits for its time, and while it sounds.

method.name: is_sounding
method.description: [code]true[/code] from the moment the note starts until it ends.

method.name: off
method.description: Ends this note, now or at [param at] (see [method MidiDriver.note_on] for [param at]). A note that has not started yet never starts.

method.name: pan
method.description: The note's position, 0 (left) to 1 (right), 0.5 the centre. Takes an optional [param at], like every message.

method.name: pressure
method.description: The note's pressure, 0 to 1: per-note aftertouch. Works everywhere: as polyphonic aftertouch where a plugin takes only MIDI. Takes an optional [param at], like every message.

method.name: tune
method.description: Detunes the note by [param semitones], fractions allowed: a glide, or a microtonal note. Takes an optional [param at], like every message.

method.name: vibrato
method.description: The note's vibrato amount, 0 to 1, as the plugin defines it. Takes an optional [param at], like every message.

method.name: volume
method.description: The note's loudness as a linear gain, 0 to 4: 1 is unchanged, 2 about +6 dB. Takes an optional [param at], like every message.
